questions.q: The average of five numbers is 24. If one of the numbers, 20, is removed, the average of the remaining four is:
questions.e: Total of five = 120. Remaining total = 120 − 20 = 100, and 100 ÷ 4 = 25.

questions.q: The average of the first five multiples of 4 is:
questions.e: The multiples are 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 with sum 60, and 60 ÷ 5 = 12.

questions.q: In a class of 30 students the average marks are 60, and in another class of 20 students the average is 70. The average marks of all 50 students are:
The average age of 8 persons increases by 2 years when a person aged 50 is replaced by a new person. The age of the new person is:
questions.e: The total rises by 8 × 2 = 16. So the new person is 50 + 16 = 66 years old.

questions.q: A batsman has an average of 40 runs after 10 innings. He scores 62 in his 11th innings. His new average is:
questions.e: Total after 10 innings = 400. After the 11th = 462, and 462 ÷ 11 = 42.

questions.q: The average of nine numbers is 28. The average of the first five is 25 and that of the last five is 35. The fifth number is:
questions.e: The fifth number is counted in both groups. 5 × 25 + 5 × 35 − 9 × 28 = 125 + 175 − 252 = 48.

questions.q: The average of three numbers is 40. The average of the first two is 35 and the average of the last two is 45. The first number is:
A car covers three equal distances at 30 km/h, 40 km/h and 60 km/h respectively. Its average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.e: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. For distance d each, time = d(1/30 + 1/40 + 1/60) = 9d/120. So speed = 3d ÷ (9d/120) = 40 km/h; the simple mean 43⅓ is wrong.

questions.q: The mean marks of 50 students were calculated as 60. Later it was found that a score of 90 was read as 40, and another score of 55 was read as 5. The correct mean is:
questions.e: The sum was understated by (90 − 40) + (55 − 5) = 100. Correct total = 3000 + 100 = 3100, and 3100 ÷ 50 = 62.
